description: This Java class implements a specific testing scenario for the Eclipse Ditto framework, configuring permissions and access control behaviors for multiple subjects within a hierarchy of resources. It sets up a scenario with detailed permissions grants/revocations and provides a method to evaluate the algorithm's ability to check permissions in the resource hierarchy.
